description: Rename a core module and update every reference across source, tests, and config.
instruction: The module `src/slugify.js` has outgrown its name: it will soon host more URL helpers. Rename the file to `src/url-slug.js` and update every reference to the old path across the project — import specifiers in `src/` and `test/`, and the module path in `config.json`. Do not rename any exported symbols. When you are done, `node --test` must pass.
